title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Set default language for documents on the company level (Default Language Code)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces a company-level default language code for customer-facing documents. This feature allows organizations to define a default language for documents like invoices and sales orders, ensuring multilingual teams send documents consistently in the customer's expected language regardless of the user's UI language settings.
key_points: New Default Language Code field in Company Information sets a company-wide language for documents
Documents use the company default language instead of the user's language setting
Improves clarity and reduces confusion for customers in multilingual scenarios
Complements existing Language Code in master data and Region property from BC22

quotes.text: Local customers will consistently receive invoices and other sales documents in the expected language, regardless of the user's UI language.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the core benefit: ensures consistent document language for multilingual organizations without relying on user settings

quotes.text: This improves clarity, reduces confusion, and ensures a better customer experience, especially in multilingual teams.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the business value and the scenario where this feature is most useful
